mission: PBUF FND-005 Experimental Consequences of the Microscopic Ontology
scope: theory and prediction only; no fitting

axioms.A1: The microscopic state has exactly three independent components.
axioms.A2: A common matter load couples equally to those components with bare scale g_dev=1/137.
axioms.A3: Macroscopic observables arise by coarse graining the microscopic state.

experimental_assumptions.E1: The three components can be independently prepared or read out with a calibrated linear map.
experimental_assumptions.E2: The common loading and readout normalization are fixed independently; linear response applies.
experimental_assumptions.E3: The components form a spatial vector in an isotropic, parity-even reference state.
experimental_assumptions.E4: A stable local quadratic long-wave theory and a specified time kinetic law apply.
experimental_assumptions.E5: Symmetry breaking is a controlled perturbation rather than an unknown apparatus effect.
experimental_assumptions.E6: A photon/effective-metric coupling maps microscopic or coarse fields to light.

predictions.prediction: Component-resolved state tomography has rank three.
predictions.classification: unique to PBUF against scalar or N!=3
predictions.falsifier: Resolved rank is not three after sensitivity and constraints are accounted for.

predictions.prediction: One normalized common source excites one bright combination and leaves exactly two orthogonal combinations dark at the source vertex.
predictions.observable: A rank-one common-source response with two null source channels.
predictions.constitutive_dependence: none at the source vertex; propagation may mix channels
predictions.classification: unique multiplicity: scalar has 0 dark; generic N has N-1
predictions.falsifier: The calibrated common vertex has nullity other than two or unequal entries.

predictions.prediction: The coherent bright-mode amplitude is sqrt(3) times one equally normalized component and its quadratic weight is three times one component; equivalently, the squared unnormalized coherent sum is three times the incoherent sum of three equal component powers.
predictions.observable: No-fit ratio R_amp=sqrt(3), R_single-power=3, or R_coherent/incoherent=3 under the stated normalization.
predictions.constitutive_dependence: independent of propagation law if measured at the calibrated source vertex
predictions.classification: distinguishable by multiplicity; generic N gives sqrt(N), N and scalar gives 1, 1
predictions.falsifier: Any normalized ratio differs beyond preregistered uncertainty.

predictions.prediction: An isotropic spatial-vector realization has one longitudinal and two transverse polarizations.
predictions.observable: One L eigenvector and a two-dimensional T eigenspace for nonzero k.
predictions.constitutive_dependence: branch frequencies are constitutive; multiplicities are symmetry-fixed
predictions.classification: unique versus scalar; not implied for a generic internal N-state
predictions.falsifier: A stable isotropic vector sector lacks the 1+2 multiplicity.

predictions.prediction: The two transverse modes are exactly degenerate before symmetry breaking.
predictions.observable: Two equal transverse poles/rates at fixed |k|.
predictions.constitutive_dependence: common dispersion is free; equality is symmetry-fixed
predictions.classification: distinguishable from scalar; generic N is representation-dependent
predictions.falsifier: Reproducible splitting remains in an isotropic limit.

predictions.prediction: If inertial dynamics applies, three polarizations occur as one L branch plus a double T branch; overdamped dynamics gives the same multiplicities as relaxation poles, not waves.
predictions.observable: A 1+2 pole pattern, without predicted speeds or gaps.
predictions.constitutive_dependence: strong: kinetic law, K, G_L and G_T
predictions.classification: conditional PBUF realization, not unique from A1-A3
predictions.falsifier: Only conditional after E3-E4 are independently established.

predictions.prediction: Weak anisotropy may split the transverse doublet; restoring isotropy must restore degeneracy.
predictions.observable: Reversible transverse splitting correlated with a controlled anisotropy.
predictions.classification: generic vector signature, not unique to exactly three components
predictions.falsifier: Nonzero intercept in the controlled isotropic limit, subject to systematics.

predictions.prediction: g_dev directly normalizes the common matter vertex, while normalized multiplicity ratios cancel its magnitude.
predictions.observable: A calibrated absolute vertex is g_dev-sensitive; bright/dark counts and normalized ratios are not.
predictions.constitutive_dependence: downstream amplitudes also require the specified response/readout chain
predictions.classification: direct coupling is distinguishable only with absolute calibration
predictions.falsifier: A calibrated equal vertex inconsistent with the stipulated g_dev falsifies A2; ratios alone cannot measure its magnitude.

predictions.prediction: No conservation law follows from component count, equal loading, or coarse graining alone.
predictions.observable: A conserved charge requires an action and continuous symmetry not present in the axioms.
predictions.constitutive_dependence: a conservation claim requires additional dynamics
predictions.classification: identical boundary for all compared ontologies
predictions.falsifier: Not applicable: this prevents an unsupported prediction.

predictions.prediction: If only one scalar projection reaches photons, scalar, three-component, and generic N ontologies can be observationally identical.
predictions.observable: No component-count discriminator in scalar lensing alone.
predictions.constitutive_dependence: complete dependence on scalar closure and photon map
predictions.falsifier: Not a PBUF signature; observation of extra coupled polarizations would break equivalence.

comparison.verdict: no auxiliary coupling degeneracy; numerical value remains postulated

ranked_signatures.signature: Bright/dark source-response tomography: one equal bright channel plus exactly two dark channels
ranked_signatures.uniqueness: N-1 dark channels directly counts N; PBUF predicts 2
ranked_signatures.realism: Simulation-ready once component source/readout operators exist; laboratory platform not yet specified
ranked_signatures.reason: No propagation coefficients or parameter fit are needed; it tests counting and equal coupling together.

ranked_signatures.realism: Simulation-ready and potentially experimental with calibrated channels
ranked_signatures.reason: Dimensionless no-fit ratio, but vulnerable to channel normalization and cross-talk.

ranked_signatures.signature: One longitudinal plus a degenerate transverse doublet
ranked_signatures.uniqueness: Separates spatial-vector PBUF from scalar; generic N depends on representation
ranked_signatures.realism: Requires a dynamical realization and directional spectroscopy
ranked_signatures.reason: Sharp multiplicity test, but not forced by the minimal ontology.

ranked_signatures.signature: Transverse splitting vanishes with controlled anisotropy
ranked_signatures.uniqueness: Tests vector symmetry, not exactly N=3 by itself
ranked_signatures.realism: Requires tunable anisotropy and systematic-error control
ranked_signatures.reason: Useful corroboration after the vector representation is established.

ranked_signatures.signature: Additional non-scalar imprint in photon observables
ranked_signatures.uniqueness: Could break scalar equivalence but is not presently predicted
ranked_signatures.reason: No photon coupling, profile, or amplitude follows from the supplied ontology.
